description: 披露主体为管理消费者和终端用户相关重大影响、风险和机遇所制定的政策，包括覆盖特定群体或全部消费者的安排。

labels.en: Policies to manage material impacts, risks and opportunities related to affected consumers and end-users, including specific groups or all consumers / end-users
labels.zh: 管理消费者与终端用户相关重大影响、风险和机遇的政策

description: 描述与消费者和终端用户相关的人权政策承诺及其来源与适用范围。

labels.en: Description of relevant human rights policy commitments relevant to consumers and/or end-users
labels.zh: 与消费者和终端用户相关的人权政策承诺

description: 说明主体在尊重消费者和终端用户人权方面的总体方法与责任安排。

labels.en: Disclosure of general approach in relation to respect for human rights of consumers and end-users
labels.zh: 尊重消费者和终端用户人权的总体方法

description: 说明主体与消费者和终端用户开展接触和沟通的总体方法。

labels.en: Disclosure of general approach in relation to engagement with consumers and/or end-users
labels.zh: 与消费者和终端用户接触的总体方法

description: 说明主体为消费者和终端用户人权影响提供或促成补救的总体方法与机制。

labels.en: Disclosure of general approach in relation to measures to provide and (or) enable remedy for human rights impacts
labels.zh: 提供或促成补救的总体方法（消费者）

description: 说明政策是否以及如何与相关国际公认文书保持一致，并指出对应文书。

labels.en: Description of whether and how policies are aligned with relevant internationally recognised instruments
labels.zh: 政策与国际公认文书的一致性（消费者）

description: 披露涉及消费者和终端用户的、未遵守联合国商业与人权指导原则、ILO基本原则和权利宣言或OECD跨国企业准则的案例性质与范围。

labels.en: Disclosure of extent and indication of nature of cases of non-respect of the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, ILO Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work or OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises that involve consumers and/or end-users
labels.zh: 涉及消费者和终端用户的未遵守国际人权文书案例

description: 说明报告年度内对消费者和终端用户相关政策作出的重大变化及其原因和影响。

labels.en: Disclosure of explanations of significant changes to policies adopted during reporting year
labels.zh: 报告年度政策重大变化的说明（消费者）

description: 举例说明政策如何向消费者和终端用户中的相关个人、群体或实体传达，包括渠道和语言。

labels.en: Disclosure on an illustration of the types of communication of its policies to those individuals, group of individuals or entities for whom they are relevant
labels.zh: 政策向相关人员传达的方式示例（消费者）
